name: Symmetry-aware Sparse Voxel DAG (SSVDAG)
definition: A compact, lossless representation of voxelized geometry that merges subtrees identical through a similarity transform (specifically planar reflections) and uses variable bit-rate encoding for pointers to reduce memory footprint while maintaining GPU-friendly traversal performance.
summary: SSVDAG is a compact volume representation that merges subtrees identical through reflective symmetries and uses variable bit-rate encoding to minimize memory while maintaining GPU-friendly traversal.
